title: The recorded open scalar comparison has its fixed-module realization normalization
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative unital rings, φ:A→B, and j:X→Z an open immersion. On the entire unbounded derived category of fixed pro-etale modules over ULift A, let E_A,E_B be intrinsic realization, s_X,s_Z the specified scalarPresentation comparisons [def-sp-et-proet-coefficient-transport], and o_A,o_B the open realization comparisons [def-finite-compact-scalar-coordinates]. The recorded open coefficient arrow reductionOpenScalarIso [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison], followed by intrinsic B-open extension of s_X and o_B, equals scalar extension of o_A, followed by s_Z evaluated on fixed A-open extension, followed by E_B of OpenScalarSite.scalarOpen [lem-sp-open-scalar-site-coherence]. No direct image, compactification, etale-origin or boundedness hypothesis occurs.

source.place: Tag 0GL6, remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings; open factor of Step 1 of lem-sp-recorded-compact-scalar-fixed-normalization. Realization, adjunction and derived-unit arguments use Stacks Tags 00YV, 03DI, 03D3, 0D6E and 07A6.

proof.text: The scalar presentation and realizationScalarIso satisfy the same scalar-unit equation. The defining right square of scalarPresentation is the conjugate of the derived section-identity realization/restriction square. Expand the conjugate, use unit naturality and cancel the realization triangles. Apply the proved realization scalar-unit equation, then injectivity of the scalar Hom bijection to identify the two left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphisms.

The intrinsic scalar transpose of sfOpenRestrictionDerived equals reductionOpenScalarIso: apply the scalar Hom equivalence, use the recorded open scalar counit square and the scalar triangle identities. The fixed scalar transpose equals OpenScalarSite.scalarOpen: descend the ordinary fixed open-unit equation termwise and apply the composite-left-adjoint uniqueness unit equation.

Apply fixedOpenScalar_realization_transport on an arbitrary fixed-module complex, substitute these three identifications and postcompose with the B-open realization isomorphism. Its inverse cancels, giving precisely the asserted square.

lean.statement:
theorem recordedOpenScalar_fixed_normalization
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))) :
    (reductionOpenScalarIso φ j).hom.app
          ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).functor.obj K) ≫
        (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j B).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((scalarPresentation φ X).hom.app K) ≫
        (FiniteCompactScalar.openRealizationIso B j).hom.app
          ((liftedScalarExtension φ X).obj K) =
      (scalarExtensionFunctor φ Z).map
          ((FiniteCompactScalar.openRealizationIso A j).hom.app K) ≫
        (scalarPresentation φ Z).hom.app
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z B).functor.map
          ((OpenScalarSite.scalarOpen (uliftRingHom φ) j).hom.app K)
